log_malloc_contract: Enable after logger and helper startup. System allocation hooks record actual Rust operations/layout/pointers at actual Rust source sites; C and Rust implementation-specific func/line,size,count,pointer differences are explicit. No fabricated C allocations or heap statistics. Real sink/gating/service/FD/order/lifecycle and ordinary no-loss control are required.
known_deferred: allocator failures and pathological address reuse
trace overflow pressure beyond ordinary workloads
